latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of freelance-developer-coach, a holistic coaching tool for freelance software developers.

- Guides developers through niche selection, positioning, rate setting, pipeline building, and scaling beyond billable hours.
- Detailed diagnostic process with 14 targeted questions to accurately identify individual needs before advising.
- Covers a broad range of topics, including contracts, platforms, tax/entity setup, scope creep, retainers, and operational risks.
- Offers actionable frameworks for picking a profitable niche and setting effective premium rates.
- Distinguishes when not to engage, focusing exclusively on the freelance/contracting journey for developers.
